title: Feature Request: Run Claude with a slash command from CLI and provide arguments
body:
I'm trying to spawn new Claude agents from a process and the first thing I want them to do is run an array of slash commands.

Something like this would be so great
`claude -slash ['/prime $ARGUMENTS', '/do_work $ARGUMENTS', '/close_out $ARGUMENTS']`

Thanks for considering it!
author: alvinycheung
